data.one_liner: A customizable rounded progress bar widget for Flutter supporting themes and icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable rounded progress bar widgets that allow color, border, and shadow adjustments. It supports child widgets at different positions, animations, pre-defined themes, and icon integration.
use_when: You need to display progress bars with rounded corners and custom themes.
You need to display icons alongside or inside progress bars.
You require animated progress bars with customizable duration.
avoid_when: You need non-linear charts or complex gauge types.
You require circular progress indicators instead of linear progress bars.
strengths: Easy to customize colors, borders, shadows, and border radius.
Built-in theme support for multiple preset colors.
Supports custom child widgets and icon integration.

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers linear and circular progress indicators with extensive customization options.

data.minimal_example:
RoundedProgressBar(
    childLeft: Text("$percent%",
        style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
    percent: percent,
    theme: RoundedProgressBarTheme.green)
